## `ovid2 etl`

Run the format → deduplicate → map → fix → write pipeline for one or more CDM tables of a pipeline.

| Argument | Description | Choices | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--input_address` `INPUT_ADDRESS` | Name of the input address config. |  |  |
| `--output_address` `OUTPUT_ADDRESS` | Name of the output address config. |  |  |
| `--pipeline` `PIPELINE` | Pipeline name (e.g. 'demo'). |  |  |
| `--batch_id` `BATCH_ID` | Batch id — the complete Data Space path of the input location (<connection>/<path>); a run label, never appended to an address. |  |  |
| `--tables` `TABLES` | Tables to process, or 'all' to expand from pipeline_settings. |  | `['all']` |
| `--transformations` `TRANSFORMATIONS` | Transformations to run in canonical order. |  | `['all']` |
| `--engine` `ENGINE` | Compute engine (default: pyspark). |  | `pyspark` |
| `--overwrite` | Allow writing into an output location that already holds tables (the address is the exact write location; without this flag the run refuses to overwrite existing data). |  |  |
| `--workers` `WORKERS` | Parallelism budget. Spark engines: number of Spark worker containers in the isolated cluster. DuckDB: number of tables run concurrently inside the single, host-sized driver container. |  | `25` |
| `--sf_database` `SF_DATABASE` | Deprecated: replaces the Snowflake address DATABASE (prefer an address naming DATABASE/SCHEMA). |  |  |
| `--sf_account` `SF_ACCOUNT` | Snowflake ACCOUNT override. |  |  |
| `--sf_schema` `SF_SCHEMA` | Deprecated: replaces the Snowflake address SCHEMA (prefer an address naming DATABASE/SCHEMA). |  |  |
| `--cdm` `CDM` | CDM name (e.g. 'pcornet_7_0'). Overrides the CDM the pipeline would otherwise resolve to via `pipeline_settings.cdm`. Consumed by the Snowflake write path to pick the right typed DDL. Introduced by C1. |  |  |
| `--stderr-log` | Mirror every event to stderr as a plain-text log line. |  |  |
| `--local` | Run the pipeline in-process on the host, bypassing Docker. Requires the [spark] extra + a JDK for the default pyspark engine (a local[*] Spark session is created). Intended for development, testing, and small disc→disc runs. Equivalent to setting OVID2_EXECUTION_MODE=inprocess. |  |  |

## `ovid2 dq_checks`

Run the PCORnet EDC / Data-Characterization checks selected by report-cycle package against an input source, writing a durable results table and a navigable JSON report. Reads CDM tables as-is (no format/map/fix chain, no pipeline package required).

| Argument | Description | Choices | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--input_address` `INPUT_ADDRESS` | Input source address name. |  |  |
| `--output_address` `OUTPUT_ADDRESS` | Where to write the results table. |  |  |
| `--input_connection` `INPUT_CONNECTION` | Storage account (connection) for the input, used with --input_location to pick the database/schema at run time instead of a saved --input_address. |  |  |
| `--input_location` `INPUT_LOCATION` | Location for --input_connection, e.g. 'DATABASE/SCHEMA'. |  |  |
| `--output_connection` `OUTPUT_CONNECTION` | Storage account (connection) for the results output. |  |  |
| `--output_location` `OUTPUT_LOCATION` | Location for --output_connection, e.g. 'DATABASE/SCHEMA'. |  |  |
| `--pipeline` `PIPELINE` | Pipeline label. Defaults to the generic 'pcornet_edc' EDC label (CDM pcornet_7_0) so one reusable run can target any PCORnet database. |  | `pcornet_edc` |
| `--batch_id` `BATCH_ID` | Batch id — the complete Data Space path of the input location (<connection>/<path>); a run label, never appended to an address. |  |  |
| `--packages` `PACKAGES` | EDC/DC report-cycle packages to run (e.g. 20r1). Runs the union of the packages' member checks. Overrides --parts; ignored when --checks is given. Defaults to the latest available cycle. |  |  |
| `--parts` `PARTS` | Check parts to run (part1..part4, mapping, freshness, integrity, completeness, semantic) or 'all'. Overridden by --packages / --checks. |  | `['all']` |
| `--checks` `CHECKS` | Explicit check ids/names to run (e.g. 1.01 DC_3_09). Overrides --packages and --parts. |  |  |
| `--list-packages` | List the available EDC/DC report-cycle packages and exit. |  |  |
| `--prev_input_address` `PREV_INPUT_ADDRESS` | Prior-refresh input address for the freshness / volume-trend panel. |  |  |
| `--engine` `ENGINE` |  |  | `pyspark` |
| `--overwrite` | Allow writing into an output location that already holds tables (the address is the exact write location; without this flag the run refuses to overwrite existing data). |  |  |
| `--workers` `WORKERS` |  |  | `25` |
| `--sf_database` `SF_DATABASE` |  |  |  |
| `--sf_account` `SF_ACCOUNT` |  |  |  |
| `--sf_schema` `SF_SCHEMA` |  |  |  |
| `--cdm` `CDM` | CDM name (default: pipeline's CDM). |  |  |
| `--stderr-log` |  |  |  |

## `ovid2 tools`

One-off utilities that share the Ovid2 address + engine stack.

### `ovid2 tools raw_upload`

Upload raw source files to the output address without formatting.

| Argument | Description | Choices | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--input_address` `INPUT_ADDRESS` |  |  |  |
| `--output_address` `OUTPUT_ADDRESS` |  |  |  |
| `--pipeline` `PIPELINE` |  |  |  |
| `--batch_id` `BATCH_ID` |  |  |  |
| `--engine` `ENGINE` |  |  | `pyspark` |
| `--file` `FILE` | Explicit file names / globs to upload. Defaults to every file in the batch directory. |  |  |

### `ovid2 tools test-engine`

Loads the named engine (either a config file under $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/ovid2/engines/ or a bare type like 'pyspark'), calls .test(), and prints the result as JSON on the last line of stdout. Consumed by the web tier's POST /api/v1/engines/{name}/test endpoint via subprocess.

| Argument | Description | Choices | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | Engine config name, or a bare type name (pyspark / databricks_spark / snowpark). |  |  |

### `ovid2 tools probe-connection`

Loads the named connection (secrets included), runs the driver auth probe, and prints one JSON object on the last line of stdout. Consumed by the web tier's POST /api/v1/connections/{name}/test endpoint via subprocess so the API process itself never holds plaintext credentials.

| Argument | Description | Choices | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | Connection config name. |  |  |

### `ovid2 tools browse-storage`

Resolves the named storage account (secrets included), calls the driver's list_dir capability, and prints one JSON object on the last line of stdout. Consumed by the web tier's storage-browse endpoint via subprocess so the API process never holds plaintext credentials.

| Argument | Description | Choices | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | Storage account (connection) name. |  |  |
| `--prefix` `PREFIX` | Sub-path/prefix to descend into. |  |  |

### `ovid2 tools list-source-tables`

Resolves the named source address (secrets included), calls the driver's expand_all_tables + table_sizes capabilities, and prints one JSON object on the last line of stdout: {"ok", "supported", "type", "tables": [spec...], "sizes": {file_name: bytes}, "message"}. Tables are ordered largest first when sizes are known. Metadata only — no data is read.

| Argument | Description | Choices | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `address` | Source address config name. |  |  |
| `--pipeline` `PIPELINE` | Pipeline name. |  |  |
| `--batch_id` `BATCH_ID` | Batch identifier. |  |  |

### `ovid2 tools probe-output`

Resolves the named output address (secrets included) and lists the tables already at its exact location. Prints one JSON object {"ok", "known", "type", "tables": [name...], "message"} on the last line of stdout. Metadata only — no data is read.

| Argument | Description | Choices | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `address` | Output address config name. |  |  |

### `ovid2 tools import-cdm`

Import a CDM spec from a machine-readable source into Ovid2 YAML.

| Argument | Description | Choices | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--source` `SOURCE` | Path to the xlsx workbook (e.g. …v7dot0_parseable.xlsx). |  |  |
| `--supplement-csv` `SUPPLEMENT_CSV` | Optional companion CSV (TABLE_NAME,FIELD_NAME,RDBMS_DATA_TYPE,SAS_DATA_TYPE) that fills in tables the xlsx omits. PCORnet 7.0 ships two tables (PRIVATE_ADDRESS_HISTORY, PRIVATE_ADDRESS_GEOCODE) only in the CSV — pass its path here to include them. |  |  |
| `--cdm` `CDM` | CDM name to write (snake_case, e.g. pcornet_7_0). |  |  |
| `--out-dir` `OUT_DIR` | Target directory (usually src/ovid2/resources/cdms/<cdm>/). |  |  |
| `--write` | Actually persist the YAML (default: dry-run, prints a summary). |  |  |
| `--vocab-destination` `VOCAB_DESTINATION` | Where to store valuesets. `inline` (default) writes them as `valuesets/<t>.<f>.yaml` with `inline_items:` blocks. Named address values are reserved for a follow-up phase — the tool prints the intended plan and exits with a warning without touching the destination address. Rationale: writing to a live DB from an offline CDM import needs a real target on the network and is deferred until the operator has a shared reference schema chosen (see the C1 ADR for the plan). |  | `inline` |

### `ovid2 tools import-vocabulary`

Import a cross-CDM vocabulary from the OMOP CONCEPT bundle (S3).

| Argument | Description | Choices | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--source` `SOURCE` | Directory containing CONCEPT.csv (and, optionally, VOCABULARY.csv). Typically the OMOP CDM v5.3 bundle. |  |  |
| `--vocab` `VOCAB` | One or more vocabulary slugs to import. Choices: loinc, snomed, icd10cm, icd9cm, rxnorm, ndc | `loinc`, `snomed`, `icd10cm`, `icd9cm`, `rxnorm`, `ndc` |  |
| `--slice-dir` `SLICE_DIR` | Directory where the per-vocabulary slice CSVs will be written. Should match `${OMOP_CDM_DIR}/vocab_slices/` used by the emitted YAML's source_path. |  |  |
| `--out-dir` `OUT_DIR` | Directory where the per-vocabulary YAML files will be written. Typically src/ovid2/resources/semantic/vocabularies/. |  |  |
| `--write` | Actually persist the slice CSVs and YAMLs (default: dry-run, prints per-vocab row counts and a sample YAML). |  |  |
| `--allow-empty` | Do not fail when a requested vocabulary matches zero rows. Default: exit non-zero so typos in `--vocab` surface loudly. |  |  |

### `ovid2 tools copy`

`ovid2 tools copy` — one-shot data move between addresses.

| Argument | Description | Choices | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--from` `FROM_ADDRESS` | Name of the source address config. |  |  |
| `--to` `TO_ADDRESS` | Name of the destination address config. |  |  |
| `--pipeline` `PIPELINE` | Pipeline name. |  |  |
| `--batch_id` `BATCH_ID` | Batch id — the complete Data Space path of the input location (<connection>/<path>); a run label, never appended to an address. |  |  |
| `--tables` `TABLES` | Table specs to copy. Each entry is either 'LOGICAL' (source basename equals logical name) or 'LOGICAL=SOURCE' (LOGICAL is the destination file stem; SOURCE is the source-side lookup key, e.g. a disc glob '*datavant_person_tokens*' or a Snowflake dbtable). LOGICAL is always used verbatim as the destination file stem — case preserved. |  |  |
| `--engine` `ENGINE` | Compute engine (default: pyspark). |  | `pyspark` |
| `--overwrite` | Allow writing into an output location that already holds tables (the address is the exact write location; without this flag the run refuses to overwrite existing data). |  |  |
| `--extra-mount` `HOST:CONTAINER[:MODE]` | Additional bind mount for the per-invocation container, e.g. /scratch/demo_out:/copy_out:rw. Repeatable. MODE is 'rw' (default) or 'ro'. Container path must not shadow the standard mount set (/app, /data, /ovid2-user-config, /ovid_credentials, /usr/include/rsa). Only accepted by 'ovid2 tools copy' — the ETL family rejects it. |  |  |

| `--overwrite` | Allow writing into an output location that already holds tables (the address is the exact write location; without this flag the run refuses to overwrite existing data). |  |  |
| `--tables` `TABLES` | Table specs to move. Each entry is either 'LOGICAL' (source basename equals logical name) or 'LOGICAL=SOURCE' (LOGICAL is the destination file stem; SOURCE is the source-side lookup key, e.g. a disc glob '*datavant_person_tokens*' or a Snowflake dbtable). LOGICAL is always used verbatim as the destination file stem — case preserved. |  |  |
| `--engine` `ENGINE` | Compute engine (default: pyspark). |  | `pyspark` |
| `--extra-mount` `HOST:CONTAINER[:MODE]` | Additional bind mount for the per-invocation container. Repeatable. Same grammar and reserved-path rules as 'ovid2 tools copy'; see ovid2.tools.extra_mounts. |  |  |
| `--strict-types` | Fail the run when source and target addresses declare different CDMs. Default is advisory-only (a warning is logged; the run continues). Matches the D6.0 route-validation contract. |  |  |

| `--cdm` `CDM` | Target CDM name (required with --source; taken from the template otherwise). |  |  |

### `ovid2 tools ods`

Read-only utilities over the Ovid Data Space: every storage account is a tree of plain directories, /<account>/<path…>. Output is JSON on stdout so the commands compose with other tools.

#### `ovid2 tools ods ls`

List the direct children of a Data Space path. '/' lists storage accounts; '/<account>/<folder…>' lists that folder or DATABASE/SCHEMA.

| Argument | Description | Choices | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | Data Space path (default '/'). |  |  |

#### `ovid2 tools ods resolve`

Resolve a Data Space path to its storage account + exact location.

| Argument | Description | Choices | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | Data Space path (e.g. /inbox/landing/2026_03). |  |  |

#### `ovid2 tools ods dimensions`

List every storage type and the addresses using it.

### `ovid2 tools describe-table`

Describe one table / data file (fields, row count, size, DDL), print JSON.

| Argument | Description | Choices | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `connection` | Storage account (connection) name. |  |  |
| `--path` `PATH` | Listing path of the table / data file under the storage account. |  |  |

### `ovid2 tools sample-table`

Print the first N rows of a table / data file as JSON.

| Argument | Description | Choices | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `connection` | Storage account (connection) name. |  |  |
| `--path` `PATH` | Listing path of the table / data file under the storage account. |  |  |
| `--limit` `LIMIT` | Rows (max 1000). |  | `100` |

### `ovid2 tools count-rows`

Exact row count of a table / data file (may scan), print JSON.

| Argument | Description | Choices | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `connection` | Storage account (connection) name. |  |  |
| `--path` `PATH` | Listing path of the table / data file under the storage account. |  |  |

### `ovid2 tools export-table`

Export a table / data file to csv / xlsx / pdf / docx, print JSON.

| Argument | Description | Choices | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `connection` | Storage account (connection) name. |  |  |
| `--path` `PATH` | Listing path of the table / data file under the storage account. |  |  |
| `--format` `FMT` |  | `csv`, `xlsx`, `pdf`, `docx` | `csv` |
| `--delimiter` `DELIMITER` | CSV delimiter (one character; 'tab'). |  | `,` |
| `--header-case` `HEADER_CASE` |  | `asis`, `upper`, `lower` | `asis` |
| `--limit` `LIMIT` | Maximum rows (default: the whole table). |  |  |
| `--out` `OUT` | Output file path. |  |  |
| `--in-process` | Run the export in this process even when unbounded (default: exports over the host row limit run in a container). |  |  |

## `ovid2 scheduler`

Poll a data directory for pipeline batches and dispatch ETL runs when they are ready. State is persisted to Snowflake or a local SQLite file.

| Argument | Description | Choices | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--input_address` `INPUT_ADDRESS` |  |  |  |
| `--output_address` `OUTPUT_ADDRESS` |  |  |  |
| `--poll-interval` `POLL_INTERVAL` | Minutes between poll cycles. |  | `15` |
| `--min-wait` `MIN_WAIT` | Minimum minutes a batch must wait before dispatch. |  | `10` |
| `--max-workers` `MAX_WORKERS` | Maximum concurrent ETL jobs. |  | `1` |
| `--data-path` `DATA_PATH` | Root directory scanned for pipeline batches. Defaults to DATA_DIR. |  |  |
| `--engine` `ENGINE` |  |  | `pyspark` |
| `--once` | Run one poll cycle and exit (useful for cron / systemd oneshot). |  |  |
| `--stderr-log` |  |  |  |

## `ovid2 watch`

Follow an Ovid2 event log and render a live status panel.

| Argument | Description | Choices | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--instance` `INSTANCE` | Instance id to watch. |  |  |
| `--log` `LOG` | Path to a specific JSONL event log (overrides --instance). |  |  |
| `--follow-latest` | Watch the most recently created event log. |  |  |

## `ovid2 service`

Install/manage the systemd service.

### `ovid2 service install`

Install the systemd unit (root).

| Argument | Description | Choices | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--user` `USER` | Unix user to run the daemon as (default: current $USER). |  |  |
| `--bin` `BIN` | Path to the ovid2 executable (default: resolved from PATH). |  |  |

### `ovid2 service uninstall`

Remove the systemd unit (root).

### `ovid2 service status`

Run 'systemctl status' on the ovid2 service.

### `ovid2 service start`

Run 'systemctl start' on the ovid2 service.

### `ovid2 service stop`

Run 'systemctl stop' on the ovid2 service.

### `ovid2 service restart`

Run 'systemctl restart' on the ovid2 service.

### `ovid2 service logs`

Tail journalctl for the ovid2 service.

| Argument | Description | Choices | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `-f`, `--follow` | Follow the journal. |  |  |

## `ovid2 web`

Serve the Ovid2 control panel over HTTP.

| Argument | Description | Choices | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--bind` `BIND` | Host:port to bind (default: 127.0.0.1:8090). |  | `127.0.0.1:8090` |
| `--reload` | Enable uvicorn auto-reload (dev only). |  |  |
| `--log-level` `LOG_LEVEL` | uvicorn log level (default: info). | `critical`, `error`, `warning`, `info`, `debug`, `trace` | `info` |

### `ovid2 web grant-admin`

Grant system_admin to a user by email, creating a pending placeholder row the next SSO login can adopt if none exists.

| Argument | Description | Choices | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `email` | Email address of the user to promote. |  |  |

### `ovid2 web list-admins`

Print every active system_admin user.

### `ovid2 web set-role`

Resolve a user by email and set their role.

| Argument | Description | Choices | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `email` | Email address of the target user. |  |  |
| `role` | New role: system_admin, pipeline_operator, viewer, guest, pending. |  |  |

### `ovid2 web reset-break-glass`

Prompt for a new break-glass password on stdin and store its argon2 hash. The password is never echoed or printed.

## `ovid2 web-worker`

Long-running daemon that consumes rows from web_jobs and spawns ovid2 etl subprocesses. Deploy under systemd via ovid2-web-worker.service.

| Argument | Description | Choices | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--max-parallel` `MAX_PARALLEL` | Maximum concurrent subprocesses (default: 1). |  | `1` |
| `--poll-seconds` `POLL_SECONDS` | Poll interval in seconds (default: 2.0). |  | `2.0` |
| `--once` | Run one tick and exit (useful for smoke testing). |  |  |

## `ovid2 mcp`

Model-Context-Protocol server that exposes the Ovid2 REST API to LLM agents. Reads/writes flow through the ovid2 web control panel.

| Argument | Description | Choices | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--transport` `TRANSPORT` | MCP transport (default: stdio). | `stdio`, `http` | `stdio` |
| `--bind` `BIND` | HTTP bind host:port (default: 127.0.0.1:8091). Ignored for stdio. |  | `127.0.0.1:8091` |
| `--upstream` `UPSTREAM` | Base URL of the ovid2-web REST API (default: http://127.0.0.1:8090). |  | `http://127.0.0.1:8090` |

## `ovid2 dev`

Start/stop private Ovid2 instances (web + worker [+ mcp]) with their own ports, state tree, session cookie and Docker image tag.

### `ovid2 dev up`

Start (and on first use, create) an instance.

| Argument | Description | Choices | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | Instance name. |  |  |
| `--port` `PORT` | Exact web port (MCP = +1). |  |  |
| `--host` `HOST` | Bind address (default: host LAN IP). |  |  |
| `--image` `IMAGE` | Docker image tag for runs. |  |  |
| `--no-worker` | Do not start web-worker. |  |  |
| `--mcp` | Also start the MCP HTTP server. |  |  |
| `--timeout` `TIMEOUT` | Startup wait (s). |  | `60.0` |

### `ovid2 dev restart`

Stop then start an instance.

| Argument | Description | Choices | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | Instance name. |  |  |
| `--port` `PORT` | Exact web port (MCP = +1). |  |  |
| `--host` `HOST` | Bind address (default: host LAN IP). |  |  |
| `--image` `IMAGE` | Docker image tag for runs. |  |  |
| `--no-worker` | Do not start web-worker. |  |  |
| `--mcp` | Also start the MCP HTTP server. |  |  |
| `--timeout` `TIMEOUT` | Startup wait (s). |  | `60.0` |

### `ovid2 dev down`

Stop an instance and release its ports.

| Argument | Description | Choices | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | Instance name. |  |  |
| `--purge` | Also delete its state tree. |  |  |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Do not ask before --purge. |  |  |

### `ovid2 dev ls`

List your instances (or everyone's with --all).

| Argument | Description | Choices | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--all` | Show every lease on this host. |  |  |

### `ovid2 dev logs`

Show an instance log.

| Argument | Description | Choices | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | Instance name. |  |  |
| `process` |  | `web`, `worker`, `mcp` |  |

Print shell exports for an instance.
